messages:
maria: Heads-up: pushing py/ts SDK release in 10m for the quiet window. final smoke + compatibility checks now. @kevin can you watch wheels and dist-tags?
kevin: on it. i’ll verify PyPI wheels and npm tarball integrity. will flag if sha mismatch.
jen: I ran the last round of unit + e2e locally — TS client ok but saw one flaky test around streaming. filed a small test skip.
arun: if streaming regression shows up in prod we should have a fallback to the v1 streaming handler. that can be toggled via config.
lydia: release notes ready, calling out breaking change in `openaiCompat` shim and deprecation timeline for sync client. added migration snippet.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: project=sdk, env=hosted, cohort=canary, tag=release-0.3.0, user=maria, started_at=1769998888
ci-bot: smoke tests started for py wheels (3.8-3.11) and npm package (node 18). logs: https://ci.internal/runs/59872
kevin: py wheels uploaded to testpypi OK, checksum matches. pushing to PyPI in 2m unless objections.
maria: thumbs up, go ahead. remember: dist-tags workflow: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.3.0 next && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.2.9 stable` for staggered cutover. for PyPI we’ll use an internal pinned index for 24h.
arun: rollout policy reminder: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% every 15m if no errors. rollback criteria: >0.5% error rate OR median latency regressed by >60ms for 5m.
jen: suggest adding infra check: if prefix cache hit ratio drops >10% we auto-fallback to quantized model variant for the dedicated fleet.
lydia: updated release notes to include rollback instructions and quick revert command.
maria: publish commands i’ll run at T+0: `twine upload dist/*` and `npm publish --tag next` then update docs.
kevin: quick note — one internal consumer still on 0.2.x pinned. coordinating with them to flip dist-tag after 24h.
jen: if we need an emergency rollback, what's the exact deploy-bot command?
arun: `/deploy rollback project=sdk tag=release-0.3.0 target=release-0.2.9 reason="prod regressions"` — deploy-bot will route to the pinned capacity and demote new dist-tag.
deploy-bot: ack: rollback command accepted (when executed by an admin). will post confirmation and rollback window.
kevin: also keep an internal mirror; if PyPI push fails we can flip `pip index` to internal index with `pip install --index-url https://internal/simple redwood-sdk==0.2.9`
maria: agreed. logging note: add a short-term alert for SDK client errors with tag=release-0.3.0 so we can roll back fast. arun can you add?
arun: already added metric alert: `sdk.client.errors{tag:release-0.3.0} > 0.5% for 5m -> pager`
lydia: final doc check: added migration snippet for TS streaming fallback, link to changelog and deprecation timeline.
kevin: smoke tests finished: py wheel 3.8-3.11 OK, npm bundle validated, canary deploy started.
maria: thanks everyone — monitoring for first 30m. ping in this thread if you see anything strange. :eyes:
jen: will post any flaky test regressions here. good luck :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary rollout complete: 10% -> healthy. next step scheduled in 15m (1769999799).
